column2: [intro]

A blend of ego and truth, a story told.
I use my image to ease the connection,
Between my audience and me, it's a deep affection.
It’s the theater of me, a life’s grand display,
Where I play my role with boldness and sway.
Between shadow and light, I find my balance,
The show unfolds, with the audience in trance.
